reason: A named lab and a batch report behind a QR code is more than most brands give me, but it is a single form of magnesium from a brand I have never heard of, made in China, on TikTok Shop. I already take a multi-form magnesium and I would need to see the actual report before paying.
objection: Why only bisglycinate when others put several forms in one capsule? And I cannot check that the lab is real or that the report is truly for this batch until I have the box in my hands.
would_change_my_mind: A full lab report I can open before buying, showing the measured magnesium per serving and heavy metals results, from a lab I can look up, plus a few independent reviews from people who took the whole box.
